name: @w6w-apps/workable
description: Manage Workable jobs, candidates, pipeline stages, members and webhook subscriptions.

w6w.longDescription:
Workable is an applicant tracking system, and this app covers the recruiting loop over its own SPI v3 API: listing and reading jobs and the pipeline stages configured on them, listing, reading, creating and updating candidates, moving a candidate to another stage or disqualifying them, reading a candidate's activity stream, listing account members and disqualification reasons, and managing webhook subscriptions.

Workable has no single API host — every account gets its own subdomain (`https://<subdomain>.workable.com/spi/v3/...`) — so the subdomain is collected once at connect time as a Connection field, the same posture this pack already uses for Zendesk and Gorgias, rather than a fixed hostname in the manifest.

Good for routing an external event — a careers-page submission, a referral, an assessment result — into a new Workable candidate, moving candidates between pipeline stages based on a signal from another system, syncing pipeline state elsewhere, or reacting to a candidate or employee event via a registered webhook instead of polling.

Out of scope for this first version: the HR/Employee endpoints (employees, time off, time tracking, performance reviews, onboarding), requisitions and offers, and the Job Board/Assessment/Video-Interview/Background-Check partner surfaces — each is its own API area this app does not touch.
